## The object

The figure-eight knot complement **m004** -- the unique arithmetic knot complement, trace
field `Q(sqrt-3)`. The programme asks what such an object forces, and reports that it forces
**form** while refusing **values**. Most results are therefore negatives, and that is the
result, not the debt.

**PROVED — `B1328`** (567 words, 0 locks)  
THE THREE 'EXTENSION OVER m000 SELECTS' INSTANCES ARE ONE MECHANISM, AND IT IS A RELATION RATHER THAN A CHOICE. Codex R037 (m004's 2T quotient class), codex R039 (the A4-to-2T lift) and the paper's own spin-lift row each report that exactly one of two candidates extends over the non-orientable parent the orientation axiom discarded. Tested as a general statement across thirteen finite groups: the restriction Surj(pi_1 m000, Q) -> Surj(pi_1 m004, Q) has fibres of size exactly #{z in Z(Q)[2] : z.phi is STILL SURJECTIVE} -- the central involutions whose twist phi^w(g) = z^{w(g)} phi(g) preserves surjectivity -- and when that count is two, exactly half the m004 classes extend and the relation to m000 fixes one bit. THE NAIVE FORM OF THE RULE IS FALSE AND WAS CORRECTED HERE: fibre = |Z(Q)[2]| is refuted by C2 and C6, where the twist is a homomorphism satisfying the relators (w kills them automatically) but LEAVES the surjections -- for cyclic C_n this fails exactly when n = 2 mod 4. With the surjectivity condition added the rule holds on every group tested: C2, C3, C4, C6, C8, C12, SL(2,3) carry surjections and match; C2xC2, C2xC4, Q8, D4, D6, SL(2,5), S3, S4, A5 admit no surjection at all, so the mechanism has no content there. THE TYPE IS RELATION, NOT SELECTION (B1327): the second relatum is m000, the manifold axiom 5 discarded, and the bit it fixes is precisely a CENTRAL Z/2 -- which is what a spin structure, a 2T lift and a 2T quotient class each are. THE LIMIT, STATED: this explains the three instances and does NOT move the colour frame (a Z/3 triality orbit with no central involution) or the Standard-Model shaping (target knowledge, not a relation to any partner). One of B1327's proposed re-types gains a mechanism; the others do not.

**NEGATIVE — `B1330`** (515 words, 0 locks)  
THE BEST-CASE OBJECT FOR THE CHIRALITY INDEX EXISTS, IS NAMED, AND RETURNS ZERO. B1324 concluded that m004's chiral one-cusped covers carry almost no cusp-trivial twists -- true of the TOWER, but the FAMILY was never searched. Intersecting the 112-member Q(sqrt-3) family (all tetrahedron shapes in Q(sqrt-3)) with chirality and with the existence of order-3 cusp-trivial characters gives EIGHT members, of which FOUR ARE ONE-CUSPED: s958, v2873, t12833, t12835. Each is simultaneously CHIRAL (so amphichirality cannot be forcing the vanishing), in the object's own COMMENSURABILITY CLASS (so the arithmetic that carries every claim survives), ONE-CUSPED (so the index applies in its own stated domain, with NO multi-cusp extension owed), and carrying GALOIS-UNPROTECTED order-3 twists. This is the object THE PAPER's section 12 says the programme still needs, and it needs none of the machinery section 12 says is missing. v2873 computed in full: 952 in-domain sectors over three primes and seven germ shapes, with t0 reaching 4 (a 4-plane in an 8-dimensional space, where half-dimensionality is a real condition) -- 680 of them at t0 >= 2. EVERY INDEX ZERO. A first pass with odd Sym powers was in the weak t0 <= 1 regime, because v2873's peripheral holonomy carries a -1 that kills odd blocks; even powers were required to reach t0 >= 2, and the same bias check that corrected B1329 caught it. THIS IS THE FIFTH INDEPENDENT REGIME RETURNING ZERO and the first on the best-case object, so the vanishing conjecture is now the strongly favoured reading and the 54 multi-cusped chiral covers look correspondingly less likely to pay. NOT DONE: s958, t12833 and t12835 carry three-generator presentations, where brute-force SL(2,F_p) enumeration is 336^3 and was not run; they are named, not computed.

## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
